providers.reason: Supervisory Board unanimously approved Future Plan 2030 on Sept 3 including 50k job cuts and portfolio streamlining; stock surged ~10%. Osnabrück site deal announced Sept 7 adds further positive flow.
providers.risk: Execution risks on large-scale restructuring and potential union pushback could trigger volatility.

providers.reason: The supervisory board approved a sweeping cost-cutting package of up to 100,000 job reductions, removing uncertainty and lifting the stock ~2.4% Friday. Jefferies reiterates Buy with a €120 target and consensus still implies roughly 25% upside from current levels.
providers.risk: 2026 sales guidance was cut alongside weak H1 results, and much of the positive news may already be priced in after Friday's pop; the shares stalled on Monday.

providers.reason: Supervisory board late Sept 4 approved historic turnaround adding 50,000 cuts to 100,000 total and halving model portfolio, averting stakeholder clash. Shares jumped ~6-7% to 11-week high, supporting momentum follow-through.
providers.risk: Cut locations/timing still to be negotiated with unions; Citi warns China share losses, EU competition and cost pressures are unchanged.

providers.reason: Volkswagen is seeing short-term technical buying opportunities as it tests support near €81. Management’s focus on a new 'competence center' for security/defense at Osnabrück and aggressive cost-cutting measures provide a pivot for sentiment, even as the company manages a difficult transition in its core EV lineup.
providers.risk: Class action litigation and severe sales volume weakness in the critical Chinese market impacting operating margins.

providers.reason: Supervisory board backed sweeping turnaround Sept 4 with deep job cuts and fewer models; hit 11-week high, Citi Buy to EUR100; deeply oversold, -22% YTD, well below fair value.
providers.risk: Sept 4 +7% spike may be priced; execution, labour resistance, China weakness and US tariffs could reverse the bounce.
